provenance.note: Built backward from 2025=100 using year-over-year CPI annual rate (index[y] = index[y+1]/(1+rate[y+1]/100)), same construction method as us.json's cpiIndex. 1989-2025 use ONS official series D7G7 'CPI ANNUAL RATE 00: ALL ITEMS 2015=100' (average of the 12 monthly 12-month-change figures for each calendar year; official National Statistic headline CPI, not RPI). 1980-1988 use ONS series JFDZ 'CPI HISTORICAL MODELLED ANNUAL RATE 00: ALL ITEMS', a back-calculated/modelled CPI series published by ONS (CPI did not exist as an official UK series before 1988 - it is modelled from RPI component data via ARIMA by ONS itself); we averaged JFDZ's 12 monthly values per year the same way D7G7 is constructed for 1989+. 2025 headline annual CPI rate = 3.4% (https://www.ons.gov.uk/generator?format=csv&uri=/economy/inflationandpriceindices/timeseries/d7g7/mm23). ESTIMATED/MODELLED years (ONS modelled back series, not official National Statistics): 1980-1988. All other years (1989-2025) are official ONS annual figures, none interpolated by us.

provenance.note: Official Bank of England Bank Rate (the BoE's policy/base rate), value in effect on 31 December of each year, taken from the BoE's full published change-by-change Bank Rate history (official series back to 1694; no estimation or interpolation - each year's value is the last rate change that took effect on or before 31 Dec that year, read directly off the BoE's own table). Used as a stand-in for a UK 'savings/1-year deposit' return since Bank Rate is the standard long-run UK risk-free/base reference rate and closely tracks retail instant-access savings rates (BoE does not publish a single standardized retail savings series back to 1980). 2025 year-end Bank Rate = 3.75% (effective 18 Dec 2025, per https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database/Bank-Rate.asp). None interpolated.

provenance.license: Index levels are public historical market data; FTSE 100 is an FTSE Russell / London Stock Exchange Group product. wallstreetnumbers.com and Wikipedia are secondary aggregators of official year-end closing levels.
provenance.note: FTSE 100 index launched 3 January 1984 at a base value of 1000 (opening level); year-end (31 Dec) closing level used for 1984-2025, price index only, no dividends (price return, not total return). Annual % return (returns.gb_stock) is the computed year-over-year % change in these closes, first available for 1985 (1984->1985) since 1984 is the index's first year and has no prior-year close to compare against. Pre-1984 years (1980-1983) are intentionally NOT included/fabricated for gb_stock: no closes or returns exist for those years. (The older FT 30 index, 1980:474.5, 1981:530.4, 1982:596.7, 1983:775.7 per Financial Times end-year values at https://media.ft.com/cms/cc9b2de0-a0d9-11e0-adae-00144feabdc0.pdf, could be substituted/spliced for 1980-1983 UK equity coverage but was deliberately left out here to avoid mixing two different index methodologies/constituents without a documented splice; flagged for a future revision if continuous 1980-1983 UK equity coverage is wanted.) None of the 1984-2025 gb_stock figures are interpolated.
